marketing.faq1Answer: Create an account with an email code, Google or a password, then go straight to the product.
marketing.faq2Question: Can I update my profile later?
marketing.faq2Answer: Yes. Change your name, email or profile photo in account settings.
marketing.faq3Question: Can I use a password to sign in?
marketing.faq3Answer: Yes. You can set or change a password from your security settings.
marketing.faq4Question: How do I close my account?
marketing.faq4Answer: Delete your account from settings. Your account data and files are removed.
marketing.faq5Answer: Requests are checked on the server, and passwords are checked against known breaches.
marketing.faq6Answer: Email support from the help page and we will reply within one business day.
